notes: Send a Global Message: the payout is confirmed from the server's own signal now. On completion the server fires ObbyUnlocked(tier, next), CashBurst(amount, tier) and TutorialObbyCompleted(tier) at the client - three notifications, one of which carries the amount the server already granted. The farm listens to CashBurst and takes that amount as the result, so an attempt no longer has to diff leaderstats and hope nothing else moved the counter; the counter read stays as the fallback for a client where the hook does not install, and the status block says which one is in use. Nothing here sends anything to the server.
